clips.text_zh: /biz/ 今晚個post問：未來10年只可以揩一樣，你擇Bitcoin定黃金？
clips.text_en_b1: If you had to hold only one for the next 10 years, would you choose Bitcoin or gold? Gold has thousands of years of history as a store of value. Bitcoin is only about 17 years old but has digital scarcity.
clips.text_en_b2: If you were forced to hold just one asset for the next decade, would you back Bitcoin or gold, and what makes your choice objectively stronger?
clips.text_en_c1: A thread on /biz/ posed a dilemma: if one were compelled to hold a single asset for the coming decade, should that asset be Bitcoin or gold?
clips.text_en_c2: Were one constrained to a single position for the coming decade, the rational choice between Bitcoin and gold hinges upon permanence versus algorithmic scarcity.

clips.text_zh: /biz/ 有人話佢每星期都睇呢條片，問應該買哪。
clips.text_en_b1: He covers the AI bubble and circular financing, the end of the USA and the rise of Europe. If you watch his videos every week, what do you actually invest in?
clips.text_en_b2: If you watched his videos religiously, what would you actually buy? Most replies recommend going long gold and short US equities.
clips.text_en_c1: If even twenty percent of his thesis proves accurate, the logical portfolio would short US equities while going long Europe, gold, and BTC.
clips.text_en_c2: Were one to internalise even twenty percent of his prognostications, the prescribed portfolio would entail short US equities, long gold, and long Bitcoin.

clips.topic_zh: AI 殺 IQ 低嘅人
clips.text_zh: /g/ 有人話ChatGPT新AGI model會取代你。
clips.text_en_b1: AI is just a tool for 160+ IQ geniuses, but for the rest of us ChatGPT's new AGI model will replace us. Mid-tier office workers are the first to go.
clips.text_en_b2: Once companies catch on, unemployment will spread rapidly across the West, because this is fundamentally an IQ problem.
clips.text_en_c1: Most anons concur that mid-tier administrative occupations face displacement first, whereas engineers and trades occupy more defensible positions.
clips.text_en_c2: Individuals of merely average intellect will find their professional competencies progressively superseded by automated systems.

clips.text_zh: /biz/ 有人post條link話關稅收咗21兆美金？
clips.text_en_b1: A /biz/ anon posted that the US took in 21 trillion dollars from tariffs. The number is so absurd it broke containment on the board.
clips.text_en_b2: Most replies noted that global GDP sits around 100 trillion, making 21 trillion from tariffs alone laughable nonsense.
clips.text_en_c1: Beneath the hyperbole lies a genuine market signal: traders continue pricing in trade-war turbulence and gravitating toward gold and Bitcoin.
clips.text_en_c2: Such fabrications, whilst fictitious, serve as barometers of sentiment about US trade policy.

clips.text_en_b1: The OP recaps a 10 year journey from gamergate to the election to china virus. The poster says it was all for nothing.
clips.text_en_b2: Anons are split between calling it cope and hailing it as the most based timeline ever.
clips.text_en_c1: The original poster concludes that the cumulative effort amounted to little.
clips.text_en_c2: Respondents partition themselves between dismissing the sentiment as mere cope and celebrating the most based timeline in living memory.

clips.text_zh: /fit/ 有條友post deadlift 220kg做咗兩下，PR俖240kg。
clips.text_en_b1: The OP went deadlifting again and hit 220 kg for a double. His PR is 240 kg. First time deadlifting in over a month.
clips.text_en_b2: This marked his first deadlift session in over a month, since he has been training at home with kettlebell clean and press.
clips.text_en_c1: His strength had not merely persisted but compounded, deadlifting 220 kilograms for a clean double after a month away.
clips.text_en_c2: He successfully completed two repetitions at two hundred and twenty kilograms, approaching his established personal record of two hundred and forty.

clips.text_zh: /a/ 有人post Gochiusa，話Koi努力做緊season 4、movie、同埋下一個McDonald's crossover。
clips.text_en_b1: Koi is working hard on season 4, the movie, and the next McDonald's collab for Gochiusa.
clips.text_en_b2: Anons are thrilled, although the franchise has been stuck on a painfully slow production cycle for years.
clips.text_en_c1: Anticipation is elevated, notwithstanding lingering anxieties regarding potential staff turnover at the studio.
clips.text_en_c2: The announcement that Koi Studio continues production of Gochiusa season four has occasioned considerable enthusiasm on the anime board.
